negative_results: A null that cannot detect a planted effect is vacuous: refuse_null_without_power raises, and the registry refuses to bind a null whose power was not proven, so a negative result from a powerless method can never be recorded.

Failing to reject the null is not proof of absence: refuse_absence_as_evidence always raises, and guard_absence_claim routes to it whenever power was not demonstrated; a bounded-absence statement is admissible only after power and only as a constraint, never a proof.

A Monte Carlo p-value is never zero: the estimate is (tail + 1) / (n + 1) with floor 1 / (n + 1); refuse_p_value_zero raises and format_p_value reports p < floor at the resolution rather than a fictitious zero.
A circular null is refused: a null whose derivation family equals the effect's family inherits the structure under test, so the registry rejects it (refuse_circular_null).

Equal temperament is not a rational-ratio control: its ratios are 2**(k/12), irrational by construction; is_rational_ratio_control returns False for it and refuse_equal_temperament_as_rational_control raises.

ISM bands are anthropogenic structure, so a flat-spectrum null over them is refused (refuse_flat_spectrum_null_for_ism); only a peak away from the ISM allocations (e.g. the 21 cm hydrogen line) may be a novel candidate.

A conclusion that flips under a mere unit conversion is a representation artifact, not a relationship (refuse_unit_dependent_conclusion); a genuine relational conclusion is invariant under positive rescaling.
A fixture-loaded resonance is not a specimen signal: refuse_fixture_response_as_signal delegates to the governance core's refuse_noise_as_resonance.

No physical measurement was performed; measured_here is nothing and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED. Every dataset is a deterministic synthetic fixture and every detection is of a planted signal placed to prove power.
reopening_test: Reopen the null-model registry if: any registered null fails to detect its planted effect or fires on its matched noise control; the H0 p-value distribution for any null stops being approximately uniform (over- or under-rejecting pure noise); a Monte Carlo p-value is ever reported as exactly zero instead of p < 1/(n+1); a non-rejection is ever read as proof of absence without a demonstrated power proof; equal temperament is ever accepted as a rational-ratio control; a flat-spectrum null is ever used over a band containing ISM allocations; a relational conclusion is ever accepted that flips under unit conversion; a fixture-loaded resonance is ever attributed to a specimen; or a null derived from the same data family as the effect it controls is ever registered. A physical run is reopened only when built, calibrated hardware with a captured raw artifact, a fixture binding, an environment log and an uncertainty budget exists.

claims.statement: A null-model registry: for every claimed effect a registered null model (noise-only, permutation, phase-randomized, span-matched, and the representation-, design-, relationship-, and physics-matched families), a Monte Carlo / permutation test statistic evaluated against it, an empirical p-value with the (tail+1)/(n+1) floor, and a proof of power on planted data enforced at registration. No effect is detected in any real data; every detection is of a planted synthetic signal.
